  WHY: A label-stripped triage issue with an invisible-character prefix would not be refused as label_missing. This needs a human edit, and the producer script never writes such a body.

Hardening suggestion: strip U+200B and U+2060 together with the BOM at line 247 (about 1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
